newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - National Power up in New York.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - National Power up in New York.

text.p: Shares in Britain's National Power Plc rose on Thursday to highlight quiet trade in American Depositary Receipts (ADRs).
European shares reflected flat trade in home markets and selling on New York exchanges following a series of record closes, traders said.
National Power rose 1-1/4 to 31-1/4 after a drop on Wednesday following a slip in half-year profits. On Thursday the Financial Times' influential Lex Column commented favorably about the company.
The Independent newspaper also said National Power was in talks with regional companies to create a combined supply business.
It reported Britain's PowerGen Plc, a National Power rival, also was in talks with regional companies, and the company's ADR rose 1-1/4 to 39-7/8.
Latin American shares were flat, with traders waiting for Friday's offering of the Venezuelan government's stake in the CANTV telephone company.
The ADR will be priced on Thursday, and CANTV is expected to become the Caracas market's benchmark stock.
"This will be a rather watershed event for them (the Venezuelan market)," said Peter Ryan, head Latin American trader at Credit Lyonnais.
Decliners led advancers by a margin of 230 to 206 among an index of 807 ADRs. Volume was 21.8 million shares in late morning.
